answer: Sybil resistance here rests on one slot per physical enclave: each agent registers hardware that signs a sealed key, and the registry accepts only one identity per device. Minting a thousand wallets is free, but a thousand chips must be bought, provisioned and kept online. Funding-graph tracing then follows shared deposits like a karst stream vanishing into limestone and surfacing as one pool, so a clone cluster shows as a single ember of stake rather than a meadow. The attacker must fund every enclave and open each cipher, turning a free spawn into real capital at risk.
